# Sample size for proportion estimation with specified precision
# Using normal approximation with exact standard normal critical value

# Parameters
p <- 0.70                    # Target proportion
z <- 1.959964                # Exact standard normal 97.5th percentile (two-sided 95% CI)
margin_of_error <- 0.03      # Half-width of confidence interval

# Formula: n = (z^2 * p(1-p)) / (margin_of_error)^2
numerator <- z^2 * p * (1 - p)
denominator <- margin_of_error^2

n_exact <- numerator / denominator

# Round upward
n_rounded <- ceiling(n_exact)

# Verify the calculation
cat("Normal Approximation for Proportion Estimation\n")
cat("==============================================\n")
cat("Target proportion (p):", p, "\n")
cat("Standard normal critical value (z):", z, "\n")
cat("Margin of error (half-width):", margin_of_error, "\n\n")
cat("Calculation:\n")
cat("n = (z^2 * p(1-p)) / (ME)^2\n")
cat("n = (", z, "^2 * ", p, " * ", 1-p, ") / ", margin_of_error, "^2\n")
cat("n = ", numerator, " / ", denominator, "\n")
cat("n = ", n_exact, "\n\n")
cat("Rounded upward to nearest integer:\n")
cat("n = ", n_rounded, " participants\n")

# Verification: check achieved half-width with rounded sample size
achieved_se <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_rounded)
achieved_half_width <- z * achieved_se

cat("\nVerification with n =", n_rounded, ":\n")
cat("Standard error = sqrt(p(1-p)/n) = ", achieved_se, "\n")
cat("Achieved half-width = z * SE = ", achieved_half_width, "\n")
cat("Target half-width = ", margin_of_error, "\n")

# Output as JSON
result <- list(
  results = list(
    list(
      metric = "sample_size",
      value = n_rounded,
      unit = "participants_total"
    ),
    list(
      metric = "exact_sample_size",
      value = round(n_exact, 6),
      unit = "participants_total"
    ),
    list(
      metric = "achieved_half_width",
      value = round(achieved_half_width, 6),
      unit = "proportion"
    )
  )
)

cat("\n\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(result, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# Using standard formulas and checking all components

# Given parameters
p <- 0.70                    # Target proportion
z_two_sided_95 <- qnorm(0.975)  # Exact standard normal 97.5th percentile for two-sided 95% CI
margin_of_error <- 0.03      # Half-width of confidence interval

cat("=== INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION ===\n\n")

# Verify the critical value
cat("1. Critical value check:\n")
cat("   qnorm(0.975) =", z_two_sided_95, "\n")
cat("   Candidate value z = 1.959964\n")
cat("   Match:", isTRUE(all.equal(z_two_sided_95, 1.959964, tolerance = 1e-6)), "\n\n")

# Check the formula application
cat("2. Sample size formula:\n")
cat("   n = (z² × p(1-p)) / ME²\n")

n_exact_check <- (z_two_sided_95^2 * p * (1 - p)) / (margin_of_error^2)
cat("   n = (", z_two_sided_95, "² × 0.70 × 0.30) / 0.03²\n")
cat("   n = (", z_two_sided_95^2, "× 0.21) / 0.0009\n")
cat("   n = ", z_two_sided_95^2 * p * (1-p), " / 0.0009\n")
cat("   n = ", n_exact_check, "\n\n")

# Compare with candidate
cat("3. Comparison with candidate:\n")
cat("   Candidate exact: 896.340406\n")
cat("   Our calculation: ", n_exact_check, "\n")
cat("   Difference:", abs(n_exact_check - 896.340406), "\n\n")

# Verify rounding
n_rounded_check <- ceiling(n_exact_check)
cat("4. Rounding verification:\n")
cat("   ceiling(", n_exact_check, ") =", n_rounded_check, "\n")
cat("   Candidate rounded: 897\n")
cat("   Match:", n_rounded_check == 897, "\n\n")

# Verify achieved half-width
cat("5. Achieved half-width verification:\n")

cat("   Achieved half-width = z × SE =", z_two_sided_95, "×", achieved_se, "\n")

cat("   Target half-width = 0.03\n")
cat("   Achieved meets target:", achieved_hw <= 0.03, "\n\n")

# Check assumptions: normal approximation adequacy

cat("   np = 897 × 0.70 =", np, "(should be > 5)\n")
cat("   n(1-p) = 897 × 0.30 =", n_1mp, "(should be > 5)\n")
cat("   Both conditions met:", (np > 5) && (n_1mp > 5), "\n\n")

# Summary
cat("=== SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("All numerical calculations verified\n")
cat("Formula correctly applied\n")
cat("Critical value correct\n")
cat("Rounding direction correct\n")
cat("Achieved precision meets requirement\n")
cat("Normal approximation assumption satisfied\n")

# JSON output for verification

  checks = list(
    critical_value_match = isTRUE(all.equal(z_two_sided_95, 1.959964, tolerance = 1e-6)),
    exact_n_match = isTRUE(all.equal(n_exact_check, 896.340406, tolerance = 1e-5)),
    rounded_n_match = (n_rounded_check == 897),
    achieved_precision_meets_target = (achieved_hw <= 0.03),
    normal_approx_adequate = ((np > 5) && (n_1mp > 5))
  ),
  values = list(
    z_calculated = z_two_sided_95,
    n_exact = n_exact_check,
    n_rounded = n_rounded_check,
    achieved_half_width = achieved_hw,
    target_half_width = margin_of_error
  )
)

# Evidence e1; success=true

# Sample size for proportion estimation with specified precision
# Using normal approximation with exact standard normal critical value

# Parameters
p <- 0.70                    # Target proportion
z <- 1.959964                # Exact standard normal 97.5th percentile (two-sided 95% CI)
margin_of_error <- 0.03      # Half-width of confidence interval

# Formula: n = (z^2 * p(1-p)) / (margin_of_error)^2
numerator <- z^2 * p * (1 - p)
denominator <- margin_of_error^2

n_exact <- numerator / denominator

# Round upward
n_rounded <- ceiling(n_exact)

# Verify the calculation
cat("Normal Approximation for Proportion Estimation\n")
cat("==============================================\n")
cat("Target proportion (p):", p, "\n")
cat("Standard normal critical value (z):", z, "\n")
cat("Margin of error (half-width):", margin_of_error, "\n\n")
cat("Calculation:\n")
cat("n = (z^2 * p(1-p)) / (ME)^2\n")
cat("n = (", z, "^2 * ", p, " * ", 1-p, ") / ", margin_of_error, "^2\n")
cat("n = ", numerator, " / ", denominator, "\n")
cat("n = ", n_exact, "\n\n")
cat("Rounded upward to nearest integer:\n")
cat("n = ", n_rounded, " participants\n")

# Verification: check achieved half-width with rounded sample size
achieved_se <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_rounded)
achieved_half_width <- z * achieved_se

cat("\nVerification with n =", n_rounded, ":\n")
cat("Standard error = sqrt(p(1-p)/n) = ", achieved_se, "\n")
cat("Achieved half-width = z * SE = ", achieved_half_width, "\n")
cat("Target half-width = ", margin_of_error, "\n")

# Output as JSON
result <- list(
  results = list(
    list(
      metric = "sample_size",
      value = n_rounded,
      unit = "participants_total"
    ),
    list(
      metric = "exact_sample_size",
      value = round(n_exact, 6),
      unit = "participants_total"
    ),
    list(
      metric = "achieved_half_width",
      value = round(achieved_half_width, 6),
      unit = "proportion"
    )
  )
)

cat("\n\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(result, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))
